properties.name: Reference
properties.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), Also referred to as "construction type". It should be provided as an alternative to the name of the "object type", if the software does not support object types and no classification reference to a recognized classification system used.IFC4.3.0.0 DEPRECATION  The Reference property is deprecated and shall no longer be used, use attribute Name on the relating type instead.

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

propertySets.name: Pset_OnSiteTelecomControlUnit
propertySets.definition: Properties for on-site telecom control unit used for railway.

properties.name: HasEarthquakeAlarm
properties.definition: Indicates whether the on-site control unit includes earthquake alarm function.

properties.name: HasEarthquakeCollection
properties.definition: Indicates whether the on-site control unit collects earthquake information.

properties.name: HasForeignObjectCollection
properties.definition: Indicates whether the on-site control unit collects foreign object information.

properties.name: ControllerInterfaceType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of serial interface used by the device.

properties.name: HasOutputFunction
properties.definition: Indicates whether the on-site control unit includes an output function.

properties.name: HasRainCollection
properties.definition: Indicates whether the on-site control unit collects information on rain.

properties.name: HasSnowCollection
properties.definition: Indicates whether the on-site control unit collects information on snow depth.

properties.name: HasWindCollection
properties.definition: Indicates whether the on-site control unit collects information on wind.

propertySets.name: Qto_ControllerBaseQuantities
propertySets.definition: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all occurrences of controller.
